$comment: Pack builder input. Boards and libraries are data: edit this file (or pass --config) to build a pack for another set. Library specs use PlatformIO package syntax; 'dir' groups libraries by arch like the AI Hub image (/opt/pio-libs/<dir>): 'all' = every board.
$extraHeadersComment: Curated ESP-IDF headers a sketch may include directly (on top of the closure of Arduino.h + framework/allowed libraries + C/C++ std headers). Confirmed 2026-11-19 (incl. fb_gfx.h for the camera examples, esp32/ulp.h for ULP deep sleep). Entries are #include names; '*' globs one directory level.
